## [1.2.0](https://github.com/lorizisback/morphe-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-10-31)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* give Batch GBIT its own icon before Patches ([20ea219](https://github.com/lorizisback/morphe-patches/commit/20ea219e641998f48537c6988457916b06b18d70))
* include valid purchases in Batch Go Back in Time ([abe99e9](https://github.com/lorizisback/morphe-patches/commit/abe99e92152aeaaa1e95260da21af828ff34e752))
* snap batch cards and reset completed flows ([b5ebdc0](https://github.com/lorizisback/morphe-patches/commit/b5ebdc0743c6652e33aede3ccdcfd3481b77640a))

### ✨ New Features

* add Batch GBIT toggle and collapse tile checklist ([c49dc02](https://github.com/lorizisback/morphe-patches/commit/c49dc02e612dd79ba10c5fb12851a4ecb2d1981d))

patches.name: Accept any signing certificate
patches.description: Disables Curve's local signing-certificate mismatch check so any APK signing key can be used. Other device checks, login and server integrity remain unchanged.

patches.name: Batch Go Back in Time
patches.description: Adds Batch GBIT to Launchpad. Select purchases, choose one funding card and follow sequential moves in a foreground progress notification. Curve eligibility and fees still apply.

patches.name: Disable optional telemetry
patches.description: Disables known analytics, marketing, crash and performance reporting. Removes Braze promotions and attribution. Account, payment, security and support services still communicate with their servers.

patches.name: Hide Flex
patches.description: Hides Flex cards, promotions, transaction actions, settings and navigation. Does not cancel Flex or change the payment source.

patches.name: Patches menu
patches.description: Adds Patches settings for Hide Flex and hiding selected Launchpad tiles.

patches.name: Remove Cringe
patches.description: Plain feature names and copy in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Lithuanian and Norwegian. Adds an optional switch in Patches. Keeps Go Back in Time, Magic link, Fronted and Flex.
